items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: And Bruce Vilanch, who ended up writing for Bette Midler and for the Oscars... So those were our writers.

ctx.x: Yes. The Cockettes were a legendary, groundbreaking sort of performance art music group in San Francisco of, let’s say, gender-bending people, and very forward thinking. So Faye was on board. And Bruce Vilanch, who ended up writing for Bette Midler and for the Oscars, and a very big and funny man. So those were our writers. And then we had their writers, who were trying to keep it really stupid and dumb so that we would appeal to the middle of the country, which we never did. So that was that. We had some great…
